title: ADR-04 Monitor detectors, graded containment and lineage hold
outcome: Data-invariant detectors (IBAN checksum, price delta vs frozen baseline, ledger balance, beneficiary-changed-then-paid), attribution by write_set lookup, suspend→revoke/release, per-action lineage hold from recorded read sets; due 24 Nov (tara consults on detectors)
acceptance: ADR file ≤900 words with sections Context, Decision, Consequences, Interface touched (which of C1–C6), Tests that prove it

Detect and attribute are separate steps emitting C4 Alert{detector, evidence_seqs, suspect, root_candidates, hard}; auto-suspend only on hard evidence (scope breach, I-class invariant breach, class U); tamper alert freezes recovery, suspends nobody
Lineage hold is per action using recorded read sets only (agent-declared lineage never trusted); release = un-hold + restore epoch; hold window is one config value
Tests listed map to RT9 (laundering: A in top-3), RT10 (0 irreversible tainted released), RT11 (framing DoS), RT12 (persistence)
summary: Call #2 freeze applied: root_candidates[0]=writer of evidence_versions, read-reached never auto-suspended, hard/soft table tied to D7 (tamper/stall never hard, freeze by kind), inv.pii_egress for F3, beneficiary evidence = payee field object, release = fresh epoch lifting suspension holds only, unhold semantics. Amendments changelog added; Maya 1-9 addressed.
review:
[maya · changes] CHANGES (maya). Structure, the D7 hard/soft table, connection-only signature suspends, the tamper freeze, per-action hold from recorded read sets, console-only revoke and the RT9-RT12 mapping are all good. Accepted: suspect = root_candidates[0] (derived, never stored). Fix these before build:
1. ATTRIBUTION RANK (blocker, anti-framing). Ranking by "earliest causal write" over the backward walk lets a rogue frame any honest upstream agent. Example: rogue triage reads intake's ticket, then writes EVIL; intake has the earlier write, ranks first and gets auto-suspended. Define root_candidates[0] as the attributed writer of evidence_versions (write_set lookup, as in the issue outcome and PANEL 3.3 "crm suspended"). Upstream agents reached only through read sets rank after it and are never auto-suspended. More than one distinct writer, or none, means no suspend (escalate). RT9 still passes: intake at [1] is in the top 3. State honestly that a laundered honest writer (crm in RT9) is auto-suspended and counted in false_accusations. Contract docstring: CON-02 M9.
2. evidence_versions for beneficiary_changed_then_paid is the payee-field version only. The payment (outbox object) goes in evidence_seqs, so the payer is never a writer of evidence.
3. §6 RELEASE: "restoring the pre-suspend epoch" revives presigned envelopes (RT4/RT5). Release sets a fresh, strictly monotonic epoch (SEC-03 B3, CON-02 M4). Agents learn it through TickFrame.epoch (M5).
4. Unhold semantics are missing. Say that a policy-time hold IS the hold/lineage_hold record (ADR-03 p.lineage_hold), and that Control{hold} is only for items already queued when the alert lands. unhold action:<rid> re-executes the same envelope through epoch, deny-list, class, policy and taint, without re-checking nonce or expiry, giving a new record linked by envelope_hash (M10). Otherwise held actions die nonce_reused/expired. An unheld outbox item goes back to queued with a dispatcher re-check.
5. witness_stall/tamper: make them not hard, with the freeze automatic by kind (SEC-03 N4, M7). Define "resolved": v1 freezes for the rest of the run (M12).
6. Say which INVARIANT detectors are hard and tie them to D7 "I-class invariant". iban_checksum fires on an R-class write; either justify it (it guards the I1 payee) or make it soft.
7. Same owner, ADR-03 §7: "Alert.suspect null" should read root_candidates empty. Also ADR-03 has comms.send_email as I1 while ADR-06 has it as I2; agree one with tara.
8. RT11 conflict: SPEC asserts payments IS suspended and false_accusations>=1, but this ADR says it is not and ==0. The ADR is right. I've asked kabir to rewrite RT11 (SEC-02 review).
9. Metric names: you use irreversible_tainted_released, ADR-06 uses irreversible_released. Tara picks; I recommend ADR-06 adopts yours.
Keep it ≤900 words (currently 888): trim Consequences.

[maya · changes] Re-review vs CALL-02 resolutions. Must-fix 1 (rank = writer of evidence_versions, bounded walk, 2+/none no suspend, laundered writer counted, RT9 crm[0]/intake top 3; H1/H2): resolved. 2 (payee field object only, suppliers:S-17.iban per X1/H4): resolved. 3 (release = fresh strictly monotonic epoch, TickFrame.epoch): resolved. 4 (unhold, policy-time hold = hold/lineage_hold, no nonce/expiry, envelope_hash): resolved. 5 (tamper/stall not hard, freeze by kind to run end): resolved. 6 (hard table tied to D7, iban_checksum justified): resolved. 7 (suspect derived / root_candidates empty; comms I1 per G1, pii_egress I1): resolved in this ADR; ADR-03 s7 wording is nisha's other file, not re-checked. 8 (RT11a false_accusations==0): resolved. 9 (metric irreversible_tainted_released): resolved. NOT RESOLVED: word limit. File is ~1235 words by wc (limit 900 per review and Call #2 rule 'ADRs <=900 words, detail into test names'); trim Consequences/Tests. Also fix s2 line 'The walk's seed is the earliest t0_seq_est': contradicts ADR-05 s4/X3 where the walk seeds from alert evidence_versions and t0_seq_est is its OUTPUT. Agreement with ADR-05: root_candidates ranking matches (writer [0], then bounded walk; RT9 [crm, intake]). Agent-view read rule: not contradicted (hold uses 'recorded read set'), but ADR-04 should add one clause that the recorded read set includes the tick's TickFrame.view entries (X2/I1), since lineage hold depends on it.

[maya · done] PMO-verified close-out of Maya's re-review: walk seed/t0_seq_est fixed; TickFrame.view read-set clause added (integration pass); length waived by D-14.

log.msg: PMO: accepted — 'suspect' is derived as root_candidates[0]; no contract field

From the kabir review of ADR-01/03: §6 'restoring the pre-suspend epoch' revives presigned envelopes (SEC-03 B3; CON-02 maya M4). Release must set a fresh epoch and lift only suspension holds, with lineage/sensitive holds surviving (CON-02 K15). Also: a sig_ok deny/out_of_scope (p.scope, ADR-03) is your scope detector's evidence. Without that, it never fires, because the gateway denies first.
Call #2 freeze adopted — apply your items from CALL-02/resolutions.md assignment table + amendments X1–X9 as an 'Amendments (Call #2)' section
PMO D-14: 900-word cap waived (≤1,500). Length-only findings closed; substantive items go to the integration pass.
integration pass: walk seeds from evidence_versions, t0_seq_est is output; read set includes TickFrame.view
